# Arthritis Foundation

> > The Arthritis Foundation is the leading nonprofit organization providing comprehensive resources on arthritis types, treatments, research partnerships, and patient advocacy.

The site offers evidence-based information on conditions like rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, and juvenile arthritis, along with drug guides for NSAIDs and other medications. It supports patients through educational content, fundraising events, workplace wellness programs, and collaborations with organizations like CARRA, ACR, and Hospital for Special Surgery.

## Key Topics

- Rheumatoid arthritis
- Osteoarthritis
- Juvenile arthritis
- NSAIDs (Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs)
- Joint pain
- Diclofenac epolamine
- CARRA (Childhood Arthritis and Rheumatology Research Alliance)
- Pediatric rheumatology
- Topical pain relief
- Arthritis diagnosis
- Drug guides
- Research partnerships
- Patient advocacy
- Workplace wellness

## Arthritis Types & Conditions

- [When Knee Pain May Mean Arthritis](https://www.arthritis.org/health-wellness/about-arthritis/where-it-hurts/when-knee-pain-may-mean-arthritis): Knee pain causes: osteoarthritis, RA, gout, and reactive arthritis
- [Mixed Connective Tissue Disease](https://www.arthritis.org/diseases/mixed-connective-tissue-disease): MCTD overview: overlap disease with lupus, scleroderma, myositis symptoms
- [Do Adults Have Juvenile Arthritis?](https://www.arthritis.org/juvenile-arthritis/transitions/do-adults-have-juvenile-arthritis): JIA transition to adulthood: classification and disease differences

## Drug Guides & Medications

- [Diclofenac epolamine (transdermal)](https://www.arthritis.org/drug-guide/nsaids/diclofenac-epolamine-(transdermal)): NSAID drug guide for Diclofenac epolamine (Flector, Licart) skin patch

## Research & Partnerships

- [Arthritis Organizations & Partnerships](https://www.arthritis.org/science/partnerships-collaborations/our-partnerships): Arthritis Foundation partnerships with ACR, CARRA, and research orgs
- [Past Howley Prize Recipients](https://www.arthritis.org/science/impact/past-howley-prize-recipients): Lee C. Howley Sr. Prize past recipients for arthritis research achievements

## Living with Arthritis

- [Exercise at Your Desk](https://www.arthritis.org/partnership/atwork/at-work-physical-activity/exercise-at-your-desk): Desk exercises for workplace joint mobility and arthritis pain relief
- [Arthritis in the Military](https://www.arthritis.org/liveyes/premium/arthritis-in-the-military): Military wellness guide for service members with arthritis challenges

## News & Stories

- [Joint Pain in Menopause](https://www.arthritis.org/news/news-and-events/joint-pain-in-menopause): Duke University research on hormones, menopause, and osteoarthritis links
- [Disc Replacement Rivals Spinal Fusion](https://www.arthritis.org/diseases/more-about/disc-replacement-rivals-spinal-fusion): Artificial disc replacement vs spinal fusion for degenerative disc disease
- [A Tribute to Haydee Sedlmeier](https://www.arthritis.org/news/stories-of-yes/haydee-sedlmeier-tribute): Memorial tribute to Haydee Sedlmeier's arthritis advocacy and community work

## Get Involved

- [DIY Fundraising Tips](https://www.arthritis.org/events/diy-fundraising): DIY fundraising ideas and tools for Arthritis Foundation awareness events
